summary: Lufax Holding Ltd filed a Form 6-K containing three exhibits: a press release announcing the appointment of Ms. Xiaodi Wang as Chief Compliance Officer, a press release announcing an Annual General Meeting scheduled for June 30, 2026, and an announcement to the Hong Kong Stock Exchange covering quarterly resumption progress, operational highlights, the compliance officer appointment, and continued trading suspension. None of these items constitute a special situation event. The appointment is a routine senior management hire, not a forced or abrupt change. The AGM notice is a standard procedural filing. The suspension update is a regulatory status report with no transactional or restructuring element.
